items.title: 百济神州“牛人”空降广药
items.summary:
日前，广药集团宣布，百济神州原全球执行委员会委员、创新中心首席执行官兼生物药业董事长刘建正式加入广药集团，担任战略科学家。

广药集团表示，刘建将作为集团创新转型战略发展的核心成员，重点推动重大疾病攻关、创新药管线建设以及科技成果转化等工作。

公开资料显示，刘建曾负责百济神州创新中心创新药孵化业务，并主导建设百济神州广州生物药生产基地。

在此之前，他曾先后任职于辉瑞、赛诺菲、阿斯利康、诺华、强生制药等跨国药企，长期从事新药研发、投融资管理及药物流通工作，主导或参与ReFacto®、BENEFIX®、FluMist®、ACAM2000®等20余款创新产品上市。

此次引进刘建，也是广药集团推进“5+5”高端领军人才计划的重要举措。

该计划聚焦细胞与基因治疗（CGT）、抗体药物、核酸药物、核医疗及AI+研发五大战略领域，按照战略科学家、首席科学家、资深科学家、高级科学家和科研专家五个层级建设高端人才梯队。

目前，包括刘建在内，广药集团已引进或正在引进的“5+5”高端领军人才已接近20人。

（编辑｜晓琳 制图｜遥望）

items.title: Drug Repurposing for Unmet Medical Needs; Request for Information; Extension of Comment Period
items.titleEn: Drug Repurposing for Unmet Medical Needs; Request for Information; Extension of Comment Period
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA, the Agency, or we) is extending the comment period for the notice entitled "Drug Repurposing for Unmet Medical Needs; Request for Information" that appeared in the Federal Register of May 12, 2026 (91 FR 25897). In the notice, FDA requested comments to solicit input on FDA's efforts with respect to drug repurposing to address unmet medical needs. The Agency is taking this action to allow interested persons additional time to submit comments.

items.title: Recommendations on Scale-Up and Postapproval Changes Guidances for Industry; Request for Comments; Reopening of the Comment Period
items.titleEn: Recommendations on Scale-Up and Postapproval Changes Guidances for Industry; Request for Comments; Reopening of the Comment Period
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or the Agency) is reopening the comment period for the request for information and comments that appeared in the Federal Register of March 3, 2026. In the notice, FDA requested comments on the Agency's series of guidances for industry on scale-up and postapproval changes for specific dosage forms. The Agency is taking this action to allow interested persons additional time to submit comments.
